gate: G-CLASSBIND (folded into G-AUDIT as calibration evidence)
authority_note: Worker-068 measurement evidence only. Does not set node status, validation_status=passed, any gate verdict, or adopt any rule. The controller and group leads adjudicate. No canonical path is written; all stage runs use a worker-068-owned pinned snapshot.
question: Does a different execution agent (worker-068, not the corpus author worker-084) reproduce, fixture-by-fixture at a fully pinned rev13 / FROZEN-rev29 shadow, the FORM-HELDOUT-10 verdicts and aggregates reported by worker-084? Secondary: does every heldout-10 mutant differ structurally from its own arm base, and by how many leaves?
why_this_task: FORM-HELDOUT-10 (worker-084) is the largest rev13-pinned class-binding escape census (33 mutants / 19 families / 7 controls; informative C2+C0 arms 26/26 union escape). Its existing terminal verification was performed by worker-084 and is explicitly limited: 'Independence is process-level (fresh re-run from preserved bytes), not third-party: the verifier shares the worker-084 id with the corpus executor.' No other agent has re-run it. This task supplies the missing cross-agent executor independence. It is a replication, not a re-authoring: no fixture, label, stage, or canonical byte is modified.

independence_statement.honest_scope: Cross-agent, NON-BLIND replication. Worker-068 has read the heldout-10 report and raw verdicts, so this is not a blind review. Independence is executor-level (different agent id, independently written runner/parser/diff, fresh subprocesses, worker-068-owned pinned snapshot) and does not substitute for a blind third-party label adjudication.

prior_independent_check.limit: same agent id as the corpus executor

live_pin_check_at_preregistration.method: sha256 of every pinned path read from the live tree before any stage run

method.shadow: Copy every pinned input and every heldout-10 fixture (bases, 33 mutants, 4 authored controls, 3 frozen canonical controls) plus the replication target (worker-084 manifest, raw_verdicts, report) into artifacts/worker-068/heldout10xagent15/snapshot/ preserving relative paths. Stage A resolves rule_spec.json and KEY_MANIFEST.json relative to its own location, so the snapshot mirrors artifacts/formulation/{tools,KEY_MANIFEST.json,rule_spec.json}. The manifest of the snapshot is hashed before any stage process starts.
method.measurement_rule: union escape = stage A pass AND stage B accept; structural escape = stage A pass; semantic escape = stage B accept. An arm is informative only if its frozen canonical control is accepted by both stages. Controls (3 frozen canonical + 2 conforming + 2 negated-phrase) must be accepted by both stages for strict validity (H5); this is evaluated and reported regardless of outcome.
method.verdict_comparison: Per fixture, compare {stage A verdict, stage A failed_rules, stage B verdict, stage B failed_rules} against worker-084 raw_verdicts.json entries. Agreement requires verdict equality and failed_rules set equality on both stages. Controls are matched by manifest path.
method.mutation_isolation_audit: Secondary, worker-068-authored and mechanical: parse each mutant and its own declared arm base with PyYAML, flatten to leaf paths, and report every changed leaf path with a value preview. Flags: zero changed leaves (corpus integrity failure), parse error, or a mutant whose declared base hash does not match the base file used.
method.aggregates_recomputed: all mutants, informative arms only (C2+C0), uninformative arm (W), escape families, caught families - recomputed from the replication's own verdicts, not copied.

pre_registered_predictions.note: Recorded BEFORE any stage run in this task, from the pinned worker-084 raw verdicts. A prediction that fails is a replication disagreement and is reported as such, not explained away.
pre_registered_predictions.invalid_reason_contains: control af_wcc_vacuum.yaml rejected: stage B reject ['R03']

acceptance_criteria.A7_stop_rule: One shadow build, one stage pass, one report, one checkpoint, outbox events, exit. Budget 0.9 agent-hours.

falsifier: Any per-fixture verdict or failed_rules disagreement with the pinned worker-084 raw verdicts; any snapshot byte that differs from the manifest before or after the run; any pinned live input that drifts during the run; any mutant with zero changed leaves against its own base or an unparseable document; a parse error or crash in either stage; or a replication aggregate that differs from the pre-registered prediction.
next_falsifier: A blind third-party label adjudication of the heldout-10 families (this replication cannot supply it); a repaired stage-B R03 plus a re-run making the W arm informative; or any pinned-hash change that voids the affected row.
non_claims: No gate verdict, node completion, validation_status=passed, or rule adoption.
No mathematical claim about cosmic censorship; the stages are mechanical class-binding instruments.
No claim of blind independence: worker-068 has seen worker-084's reported verdicts.
No claim that a replicated escape is a genuine class-contract violation; that needs independent label adjudication.
